label: alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: A phenotype in which a microorganism produces active alpha-mannosidase enzymes that hydrolyze terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-mannose residues in alpha-D-mannosides.
observations: Follow-up from the physiology diagnostic-enzyme gap sweep; absent from METPO and TraitMech after an alpha-mannosidase duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
